intro: July 6 — structural framework update. Three changes from July 5 long-term view: (1) ★★ SK HYNIX DOWNGRADED to WATCH / exit in progress — Stop Day 2 confirmed (KRX close ₩2,343,000, two consecutive closes below ₩2,540,000 stop threshold); mandatory full exit at July 7 KST open; long-term SK Hynix structural thesis intact but position must exit per protocol; evaluate SKHY (Nasdaq ADR, July 10 listing) as separate instrument post-exit. (2) BTC conviction maintained at MEDIUM with Gate 2 intact ($62,849 / $849 above $62,000) but 10-hour declining session reduces tactical urgency; Gate 3 (IBIT) verify at 9:30 AM ET today. (3) NVDA Stop Day 2 binary today (close >$195 = Stop Day 1 isolated; close ≤$195 = mandatory July 7 exit) — long-term Blackwell Ultra/sovereign AI capex thesis entirely unchanged regardless of stop protocol outcome. All other structural positions (META, MSFT, MU, SPCX, GOOGL) unchanged from July 5 long-term view.

ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.timeframe: 6–12 months (through FY27 earnings cycle; nearest catalyst August 26 Q2 FY27 earnings)
ideas.idea: NVDA long-term structural conviction maintained at HIGH through the Stop Day 2 binary (determined at July 6 US close). The short-term stop protocol does not alter the 12-month Blackwell Ultra / sovereign AI capex thesis. Pre-market $195.33 (only $0.33 above $195 stop threshold) — Stop Day 2 determination is at the official US close today. If Stop Day 1 isolated (close >$195): full-size add gate July 7 open (NVDA >$200 + SPX >7,460 + VIX <17 at 9:25 AM ET). If Stop Day 2 triggered (close ≤$195): mandatory exit July 7 open — but this is a tactical position management event, NOT a fundamental change. The long-term thesis reasserts on re-entry when gates are met. H200 China: BIS rule authorized January 16, 2026 (case-by-case export licenses, 25% tariff) but China has NOT yet permitted imports and zero H200 revenue generated. First import license issuance remains the single largest unmodeled upside catalyst: $7–10B annualized China revenue not in any Street estimate.
ideas.why: Blackwell Ultra (GB300 NVL72 = 1.5x GB200 performance) is shipping. Sovereign AI capex from EU, Japan, Saudi Arabia, UAE at $100B+ combined is contractually committed multi-year spend. NVDA's CUDA software moat requires 18–24 months to replicate — AMD and Intel cannot close in FY27. Every major hyperscaler committed multi-year NVDA GPU purchases in Q1 2026 earnings. August 26 Q2 FY27 earnings ($91B guide) is the fundamental re-rating event. Nicholas Parker (MSFT field ops) joining NVIDIA signals enterprise GTM infrastructure scale-up at exactly the right moment. The stop protocol is position management — not thesis invalidation.
ideas.driver: China H200 import license issuance (first licenses expected Q3 2026; unlocks $7–10B annualized unmodeled revenue); Blackwell Ultra GB300 GPU ramp H2 2026 (1.5x vs GB200; 3x vs H100); sovereign AI capex $100B+ combined; inference demand scaling as AI moves from development to deployment; Q2 FY27 earnings August 26 ($91B guide); Rubin architecture 2027 extending moat; Nicholas Parker (MSFT) enterprise GTM scaling

ideas.name: Micron Technology
ideas.timeframe: 3–6 months (through Q4 FY26 earnings September 2026; structural 12–18 months through HBM4 supercycle)
ideas.idea: MU long-term structural conviction maintained at HIGH. The Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM narrative is a MICRON STRUCTURAL POSITIVE: mobile DRAM share shifting to CXMT (Pentagon 1260H blacklisted) amplifies the US government AI procurement mandate for Micron's Idaho HBM4. DoD cannot use CXMT by law — every HBM4 wafer from Micron's Idaho CHIPS Act fab is DoD-compliant by jurisdiction. $50B Q4 FY26 guide (+40% above prior consensus) confirmed; HBM4 sold out through 2026. No stop protocol, no gate conditions, no ADR mechanics — cleanest structural long in the portfolio. SK Hynix Stop Day 2 today creates a tactical Korea-sympathetic dip opportunity at $1,150–$1,200 on July 6 open.
ideas.why: The CXMT/YMTC blacklist amplification thesis is underappreciated: DoD AI procurement mandates specifically require US-manufactured memory, and CXMT's blacklist status makes Chinese DRAM non-compliant for the entire US government AI pipeline. SK Hynix Stop Day 2 and mandatory exit does NOT damage the HBM4 demand cycle thesis — it represents position management protocol, not fundamental semiconductor demand deterioration. MU is the US proxy for the same HBM4 supercycle that SK Hynix was capturing. Samsung $226B AI data center commitment validates $50B Q4 FY26 guide at national-government scale. HBM market oligopoly (Samsung/SK Hynix/Micron) enforces pricing discipline — no fourth entrant in 24 months.
ideas.driver: HBM4 ramp through H2 2026 ($50B Q4 FY26 guide confirmed); CHIPS Act Idaho fab DoD compliance advantage (Pentagon 1260H blacklist amplification); DoD AI procurement mandate for US-manufactured HBM; September Q4 FY26 earnings confirming demand cycle duration and HBM4 ASP premium; oligopolistic HBM pricing discipline; Korea semiconductor recovery as structural HBM validation

ideas.name: SK Hynix
ideas.timeframe: EXIT in progress (mandatory July 7 KST open); then evaluate SKHY (Nasdaq ADR, July 10 listing) as separate instrument
ideas.idea: DOWNGRADED to WATCH / EXIT IN PROGRESS. Stop Day 2 confirmed (KRX close ₩2,343,000 — second consecutive close below ₩2,540,000 threshold). Mandatory full exit at July 7 KST open (9:00 AM KST = 00:00 UTC July 7). The long-term SK Hynix structural thesis — ~70% HBM4 revenue from AI data centers, world's largest HBM3e/HBM4 supplier, NVDA Blackwell B300 primary partner — is entirely unchanged. The exit is a position management protocol event, not a fundamental thesis invalidation. Post-exit path: evaluate SKHY (Nasdaq ADR, July 10 listing, $29.4B — largest ADR in history) as a completely separate instrument after the KRX position is flat. SKHY listing + MSCI World inclusion process (2–3 quarters post-listing) are the structural secondary catalysts. Re-evaluate KRX re-entry after establishing a new stop framework above ₩2,540,000.

The ADR listing on July 10 creates a separate, cleaner instrument (SKHY on Nasdaq) that will be accessible to US institutional buyers without the KRX-specific stop protocol complexity. MSCI World inclusion (typically 2–3 quarters post-Nasdaq listing for a $29.4B stock) creates systematic demand that does not exist for the KRX-listed shares. Post-exit: SKHY is potentially the higher-conviction instrument going forward if HBM4 thesis remains intact through July 10 listing.

ideas.idea: META carries the highest long-term conviction of any big-tech name on a risk-adjusted basis. Conviction maintained at HIGH. The most direct AI-to-revenue conversion path in the portfolio: every AI ad targeting improvement reaches 3.3B daily active users in real-time without enterprise sales cycles, semiconductor sourcing complexity, or geopolitical trade risk. Zero exposure to Korea shock, H200 China policy, HBM4 supply chain, BTC gates, or SPCX bond distribution. FCF $60B+ annual makes META the most rate-resistant large-cap AI name in the Warsh hawkish hold environment. Q2 2026 earnings (late July) = first full AI-feature quarter at scale — setup for beat and raise. SK Hynix Stop Day 2 today has zero impact on META's revenue model.
ideas.why: 3.3B daily active users is an unassailable data and distribution moat. Llama 4 open-source flywheel builds developer ecosystem lock-in with no chip dependency. Zuckerberg AI personal assistant has genuine distribution at scale — improvements reach 3.3B users immediately. META is uniquely insulated from every geopolitical and semiconductor risk identified in this framework. Every macro event in this framework period (Korea shock, NVDA stop, BTC gates, SPCX distribution) is zero-impact on META's revenue model. This makes META the risk-adjusted anchor of the big-tech allocation.

ideas.name: Microsoft Corporation
ideas.idea: Microsoft long-term conviction maintained at MEDIUM. Most diversified AI monetization play with strongest rate resilience in big-tech. Azure AI cloud (OpenAI partnership exclusive enterprise deployment), Copilot productivity suite (400M+ 365 commercial seats at $30/month premium), GitHub Copilot (developer workflow capture). No Korea semiconductor exposure, no SPCX bond distribution mechanics, no stop protocol. Nicholas Parker moving FROM MSFT to NVIDIA field ops is a structural signal: NVDA is becoming the enterprise field ops focal point, which is Azure cloud-constructive (NVDA GPUs sold via Azure = Azure revenue growth). Goldilocks NFP + US BUY regime = enterprise IT budget cycle continues expanding through FY27. FOMC Warsh hawkish hold through 2027 pressures growth multiples, but MSFT's $100B+ FCF and ~2% dividend yield provide a valuation floor.
ideas.why: Enterprise AI adoption in 2026 is about Copilot seat conversion. 400M+ commercial 365 seats converting at 10–20% to Copilot Premium at $30/month = 2.5x revenue per seat vs. base tier. Azure AI workloads are sticky: switching cost is 12–24 months of enterprise IT re-integration. OpenAI exclusivity for enterprise Azure fine-tuning creates a 3–5 year switching friction moat. $100B+ FCF floor means even a multiple compression from 32x to 25x forward leaves intrinsic value intact. SK Hynix Stop Day 2 has zero impact on MSFT's revenue model.
